cefrAlignment: Matches B1 (CEFR CV reading instructions: can understand clearly written, straightforward instructions for a piece of equipment and follow a procedure): booking guides, product instructions and a workplace procedure of 200–245 words, with sequence, condition and warning language.
examFidelity: The texts and question types fit TOEFL Read in Daily Life and TOEIC Part 7. The flow-chart uses the IELTS 'NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER' format correctly, and every key fits the limit. The tips agree with exams.ts.
fixes: Moved the correct option in four MCQs (ex1 q1 and q4, ex4 q3 and q4) because too many keys were in position B.
learnerOutcome: A learner can follow the real order of steps when before, after, once and until reverse the word order, notice conditions and warnings, and transfer a procedure to a flow-chart.
